title: Unify button motion & focus guidelines; loading and disabled accessibility parity
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Multiple recent button fixes (loading spinner colors, disabled opacity, icon hit targets, and focus rings) were shipped incrementally and now exhibit inconsistent behavior across themes and reduced-motion settings. This ticket consolidates design decisions into a single guidelines page, defines token changes, and produces engineering-ready specs to avoid future regressions.

Goals:
- Define accessible focus ring contrast and offset token that works in light/dark/high-contrast themes.
- Standardize loading spinner motion (duration, easing) and color token mapping for primary/secondary/ghost variants.
- Specify disabled state semantics (opacity vs. color shift) and ARIA recommendations for screen readers.
- Ensure icon-only buttons maintain 44px touch/hit target while visually 32px.
- Produce migration notes and a small visual/keyboard/a11y regression test checklist for QA and infra.

Out of scope: major visual redesign of button shapes or introducing new variants. This is maintenance and parity work only.
comments: 2026-03-10 — Asha: Kickoff doc added with initial token proposals for focus-ring-offset and button-spinner-color. Suggested values optimized for 3:1 minimum contrast on dark variants.

2026-03-11 — Liam: Ran quick dev spike; focus ring visual looks good but breaks on inverted-high-contrast OS setting. Decided to add high-contrast overrides and tie to token 'focus-ring-contrast-override'.

2026-03-12 — Design review (Priya, Marco): Agreed on spinner duration 320ms for appear/disappear with 200ms ease-out; reduced-motion should show static spinner icon and aria-live="polite" updates. Priya asked for explicit ARIA guidance for screen readers when a button causes a background load.
2026-03-12 — PM (Sam): Prioritize migration notes for Dedicated customers; add console flag for token opt-out during rollout. Estimated 2-day lift for engineering to support theme overrides.

2026-03-13 — Liam: Implemented CSS tokens in branch and added storybook stories covering: keyboard focus, disabled state, loading (with reduced-motion), icon-only hit target. Created unit tests for focus outline presence on keyboard nav only.

2026-03-14 — QA checklist added by Nina: keyboard tab order, screen reader announcement verification, hit-target measurement, color contrast checks for focus ring on all themes, and snapshot tests for spinner states. Found one regression with ghost-variant spinner using text color; flagged in runtime PR #988.
2026-03-14 — Asha: Updated design doc with final token names and migration notes; requested design + eng signoff before merging to master.
notes_for_engineering: Tokens to add: focus-ring-offset (px), focus-ring-color (token per theme), button-spinner-color (per variant), disabled-opacity, icon-hit-target-size. Provide reduced-motion media query behavior: replace spinner animation with static SVG and ensure aria-live announcements. Engineering to add storybook knobs for token overrides and a migration guide in CHANGELOG. See PRs linked in attachments.
qa_test_plan: 1) Verify focus ring appears only when keyboard-focused (not on mouse click). 2) Check focus contrast >= 3:1 across light/dark/high-contrast themes. 3) Confirm spinner color resolves to explicit token per variant (primary/secondary/ghost). 4) Reduced-motion: spinner does not animate and has aria-live update. 5) Icon-only buttons measure >=44x44px hit target. 6) Disabled: visual opacity change but still announced as disabled to SR; no spinner shown.
migration_notes: Migration steps for downstream repos: 1) Update token imports to ds-2026.03, 2) Replace any ad-hoc spinner color overrides with button-spinner-color, 3) Add reduced-motion checks in integration tests, 4) Use focus-ring-contrast-override only for strict high-contrast flows. Engineering PR should include a short script to map old token names to new ones where possible.
release_steps: 1) Merge design doc and tokens to main, 2) Ship storybook updates and QA signoff, 3) Release ds-2026.03 alpha, 4) Notify integrators and add migration guide to release notes, 5) Monitor client-side regressions for 2 weeks.
acceptance_criteria: - Design doc approved by design leads and accessibility reviewer. - Token definitions merged and published. - Storybook shows all states and passes visual snapshots. - QA checklist completed and issues resolved. - Engineering integration PR merged with migration notes included.
